name: @bernouy/cms-content
description: The CMS content aggregate behind `CmsRepository` — pages, blocs, templates, snippets and settings (TSystem: site, editor shell, security extras, roles config), with in-memory and Mongo (`./mongo`) implementations, the theme style endpoint under `http/`, the p9r-* constants and content utils. One package because it is ONE consistency domain: entities are copied, provisioned and rendered together.
